name: config-edit-verify

files.verify.py:
import configparser

cfg = configparser.ConfigParser()
cfg.read("settings.ini")
s = cfg["server"]
assert s["host"] == "127.0.0.1"
assert s["port"] == "8080"
assert s["timeout"] == "30"
workers = int(s["workers"])
assert workers == 4, f"workers should be 4, got {workers}"
print("OK")

prompt: In settings.ini, change the number of workers from 1 to 4. Keep every other line byte-identical. Then run: python3 verify.py — it must print OK.
